questions.stem: An object is dropped from a height. Ignoring air resistance, what happens to its gravitational potential energy as it falls?

options.text: It decreases and is transferred to kinetic energy

questions.explanation: As an object falls, its height decreases so its GPE decreases. This energy is transferred to the kinetic energy store, causing the object to speed up. GPE lost = KE gained (ignoring air resistance).

questions.stem: Using v = sqrt(2gh), what is the speed of an object after falling 5 m? (g = 10 N/kg)
questions.explanation: v = sqrt(2gh) = sqrt(2 x 10 x 5) = sqrt(100) = 10 m/s. Notice this result is independent of the object's mass.
